description: An Android activity class 'Grid2' that displays a grid of images using a custom adapter 'ImageAdapter', which loads drawable resource identifiers into ImageView elements within a GridView.

classes.name: Grid2
classes.description: An Activity that displays a grid of images using a GridView with a custom ImageAdapter class.

classes.name: ImageAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter that provides ImageViews populated with drawable resources for the grid.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and sets up the GridView with the ImageAdapter.

methods.name: ImageAdapter(Context c)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a Context.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of images in the adapter.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the item at the specified position; here, just returns the position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the item at the given position; here, the position itself.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses an ImageView for displaying the image at the specified position in the grid.
